value.name: drafts legal agreements
value.description: Asha drafts a partition-in-use agreement and a refinancing memorandum for Daniel and Lucia, while withholding any opinion on which structure is best.
evidence: She drafted a partition-in-use agreement between Daniel and Lucia.
She drafted the outlines of a refinancing memorandum that would, if Daniel chose to go that route, allow him to buy out a portion of Lucia's interest at a price both could accept.
She did not draft an opinion as to which structure was best. That was not her job.

value.name: returns home for dinner
value.description: On Friday evening, Asha goes home, makes dinner, and eats alone while looking out at Pine Street.
evidence: On Friday evening she went home and made herself dinner and sat at the small table by the window in her front room and ate it and looked out at Pine Street in the early dark

value.name: reflects on curtain and upcoming meeting
value.description: Asha thinks about the curtain in the second-floor window and the possibility that Monday's meeting at the Serrano house may be the last formal estate meeting.
evidence: and she thought about the curtain in the second-floor window
and she thought about the fact that on Monday she would walk back into the dining room of the Serrano house for what might or might not be the last formal meeting of the estate

value.name: recognizes others have changed
value.description: Asha realizes that the people on the other side of the table have done more personal work in eight days than she expected, and that she was somehow present for it.
evidence: and that the people on the other side of the table from her had, in the eight days since she had last seen them, done more work on themselves than she had imagined any of them capable of
and that this work was theirs and not hers but that she had been, in some way she did not yet know how to think about, present at the doing of it
value.time_hint: Monday / eight days since last seen

value.name: washes dish
value.description: After dinner, Asha washes her dish.

value.name: goes to sleep
value.description: Asha goes to sleep after washing the dish.

value.name: wakes early and skips work
value.description: On Saturday morning, Asha wakes early and deliberately does not work.
evidence: Saturday morning Asha woke early and did not work.

value.name: walks to the river
value.description: Asha takes a morning walk to the river and back, spending about an hour along the water.
evidence: She walked in the morning to the river and along it for an hour and back

value.name: shops for weekend food
value.description: Asha stops at the market and buys bread, cheese, and fruit for the weekend.
evidence: and she stopped at the market and bought bread and cheese and fruit for the weekend

value.name: reflects while walking home
value.description: Walking back along Pine Street with her groceries, Asha begins thinking about her own unfinished thoughts.
